content.short: Multiple NFT Project with Trading Cards, Collectible and Artwork.
content.description:
I'm an artist who has been active in graphic design and art for several decades and have published several collections all related to art.

My first project are trading cards. The limited trading card series, limited to 10,000 cards, will start in June 2022. The cards contain 100 motifs that are repeated and have different rarity classes. We have numbered all cards so that each card is really only available once. The cards rarity classes are divided as follows. 300 Legendary Cards, 700 Super Rare Cards, 3,000 Rare Cards, and 6,000 Common cards.

After the launch of trading cards, I will focus on launching my collectible non-fungible tokens. Most of the collectibles were created in a self-designed A.I. System created, to which we have put a large part of manual work. This collectible will also be available in different numbers and, like the trading cards, will contain artists from different genres.

The 3rd collection will be pure artworks that are only available once and contain pure art. All of our NFTs are works of art subject to artistic liberties that do not infringe any licences. We do not use any brand logos and also ensure that full names are mentioned.

In our collectible and trading cards, I have used artists that are close to my heart as motifs, but also artists from different genres such as sports, music and film.
